headline: Indian Rupee Reaches Seven-Month High Driven by Foreign Inflows and Lower Crude
summary: The Indian rupee appreciated to a seven-month high of 93.5 against the US dollar. The 42.5 paise daily gain was driven by persistent portfolio inflows and lower international crude oil import costs.
why: The Reserve Bank of India manages rupee monetary stability and official foreign currency intervention.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Foreign capital inflows into local assets directly bolstered local currency exchange values.
